name: New York-Style Steak & Eggs
method: Boil the diced potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes, drain well and leave them to steam dry for 2 minutes.

Heat half the oil in a frying pan and fry the chopped onion and pepper for 5 minutes until soft, then set aside. Fry the potatoes in the same pan for 5 to 6 minutes until crisp, return the onion and pepper, toss and season.
Meanwhile heat a griddle or frying pan until very hot, season the steak and cook it for 3 minutes on each side, or longer until cooked to your liking. Rest it for a few minutes.
Wipe out the pan, heat the rest of the oil over a medium heat and fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Serve the sliced steak with the potato mixture and fried eggs.
